 Live fact check: Election Day 2026
 Politics 
 Nov 3, 2026 6:00 AM EST
 Our partners at PolitiFact are fact-checking multiple competitive 2026 midterm races across the United States, online misinformation, lawsuits and allegations of fraud on Election Day.
 WATCH LIVE: Election night 2026 PBS News special coverage 
 Follow along starting at 7 a.m. ET in the chat below.
 You can also follow the NewsHour's live coverage on YouTube , Twitter , Facebook , and TikTok , and see highlights on our Instagram . 
 A free press is a cornerstone of a healthy democracy.
